description: After fz-sc8.183.1 the question 'where does this field end, and does it fit' is answered twice: by bs_field_end in runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs (used by the interpreter, the receive matcher via fz_bs_field_end, and re-checked inside fz_bs_read_int_ref / fz_bs_read_binary_ref) and by Cranelift emission in src/compiler2/native_codegen/prim.rs (match_field_extent, Prim::BitFieldFits, Prim::BitFieldNext). Candidate fold: lowering emits ordinary integer IR (multiply, add, compare) for the position, so native code and the interpreter share one source and BitFieldFits / BitFieldNext go away; the read's own re-check goes with it. Not blocking: found while reviewing fz-sc8.183.1.
title: A binary match's bounds arithmetic has one implementation
